parsed.reason: Description A says an expired entry popped before the size check can cause an unrelated live entry to be evicted needlessly (a cache-eviction efficiency issue). Description B says find returns the cached list object itself, so in-place sorting by a caller mutates the cache and corrupts later results for the same query. Different root causes and failures, both near the cache code but not the same defect.
